kyra: Heads-up: after the role refactor push last night, onprem admin role can't access the KMS key for control-plane backups. Seeing 403s in the private control plane logs. Anyone else?

mike_s: seeing same in dedicated staging. Error: PermissionDenied: 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' missing on service-account 'onprem-admin-svc@redwood-inference.svc'.

samir: @kyra can you paste stack trace or log line? Also which environment (eu-west-prod/staging)?

kyra: prod-vpc-1. Logs attached below:
security-bot: audit log snippet

```
2026-03-19T22:12:01Z controlplane KMS_ACCESS_DENIED serviceAccount=onprem-admin-svc@redwood-inference project=redwood-prod key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ctrlplane/cryptoKeys/backup
```

Not a SA rotation; that SA has the new role 'onprem.controlplane.admin'

elaine: Looks like role mapping didn't include kms.roles.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. The refactor split cloud roles into smaller permissions and we missed KMS binding.

samir: Agreed. Quick mitigation: grant the SA a temporary binding to roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key ring. I'll push a canary policy in prod for 5m and test

mike_s: Before we mutate policies, check if audit logs show any successful decrypts by fallback svcacct (backup-daemon). If backups can use fallback, might be fine. Query:
`SELECT * FROM controlplane.logs WHERE protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\" AND resource.labels.key_ring=\"ctrlplane\" LIMIT 10`

kyra: backup-daemon is failing too. No successful decrypts in last 6 hours.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: POLICY_CHANGE proposed by samir at 1959876600.rolling=true
status: pending_approval

samir: I'm patching a scoped binding now. Giving `onprem-admin-svc` the cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the ctrlplane key ring only. Will monitor metrics. If OK, we'll update role-template to include KMS perms.

elaine: Also need to update RBAC tests in onprem CI — add KMS permission check to prevent regressions.

kyra: Postfix: we should also add an audit alert for 'KMS Decrypt failures > 5 in 10m' for controlplane keys. Right now we only alert on KMS errors globally.

mike_s: :thumbsup: I'll file an incident ticket and capture rollback steps. Incident: INC-2026-0319-KMS1
